messages:
Ana L: Quick sync — from the postmortem we landed three follow-up action items for the missing spans / bad aggregation incident. Need clear owners + timelines so we can close them before the next oncall rotation. TL;DR: (A) aggregation shard-key regression fix, (B) span-coverage regression tests + CI gate, (C) dashboard alert tuning + backfill. Assignments?

Mike R: I can take (A). I have a small patch in progress, but want to confirm the exact rollback points and if we also need a compatibility shim for old aggregator pods. Planning a PR today.

Sophia K: I can own (B). I'll add span-level unit tests and a headless integration test that replays the failing trace patterns. Aim to get CI gate in 2 weeks. I also want to add a test that asserts per-service span counts don't drop >10% after deploys.

Jamal T: I'll take (C) — alert thresholds and the backfill. For backfill, we need an idempotent reprocessor that handles dedupe. I estimate 5 days for a first pass + run on staging.

Olivia S: Thanks. I'll validate the backfill results on analytics side and spot-check aggregation correctness. Can we also add a short eval to detect recurring patterns (same service losing spans after deploy)? Might help catch regressions early.

Mike R: Note: root cause was a shard key regression introduced in aggregator v1.2. The old key was `service_id|trace_id`, new config accidentally used `service_id|span_id` in the partitioner. Quick diff:```diff
- partition_key = f"{service_id}|{span_id}"
+ partition_key = f"{service_id}|{trace_id}"
```I'll open PR: https://redwood.internal/pr/8721 and tag reviewers.

Sophia K: For CI gate, I'll add a synthetic trace generator that emits the edge-case patterns we saw. Proposed test name: `test_no_missing_spans_on_partition_boundary`. I'll add it to the `ci/integration/observability` job.

Ana L: Good. Can everyone add their assigned ticket IDs to the postmortem doc and set realistic due dates? We want measurable owners. I'll create a follow-up checklist in the postmortem.

Mike R: Created ticket ENG-5123 and linked in the PR. Targeting 3 business days to merge + canary.

Sophia K: Ticket ENG-5124 created for tests + CI. Targeting 10 business days.

Jamal T: Ticket ENG-5125 for backfill + dashboards. Targeting 5 business days.

Olivia S: I'll add a validation note to the ticket with the sample queries I used to verify counts.

deploy-bot: deploy status: canary for `aggregator:v1.2.1-rc` reported healthy on two canary pods. (automation)

Ana L: Two quick asks: (1) add an automated regression alert to kick off when span drop rate > 7% for any service over 15m, (2) schedule a 30m sync next Tue to review progress and unblock anything.

Mike R: I'll add the alert rule to `observability/alerts.yaml` and post the PR.

Sophia K: Agree on the alert. Also proposing a lightweight nightly CI that runs the synthetic trace generator against the latest aggregator image to catch regressions earlier.

Jamal T: Scheduling the Tue sync — I'll create a calendar invite for Tue 10:00 PT and include the postmortem + tickets.

Ana L: Thanks team. Final check — owners and timelines: Mike (ENG-5123, 3bd), Sophia (ENG-5124, 10bd), Jamal (ENG-5125, 5bd), Olivia (validation). I'll mark these in the postmortem and we can close the loop next week. :thumbsup:

Olivia S: One more note — if backfill runs long we should throttle to keep ingestion unaffected. Jamal, please include throttling knobs in the ticket.

Jamal T: Will do. Adding `--max-rps` and `--batch-size` options to the reprocessor.

Mike R: PR merged to main, canary underway. tagging @oncall for visibility.

Ana L: Great progress — setting a reminder to check status after canary completes. If anyone hits blockers ping me directly.
